create.name: WCCM in the UK
create.bio:
WCCM in the UK is the British arm of the World Community for Christian Meditation, run almost entirely by volunteers as a registered charity. It teaches meditation as passed on by John Main, the Benedictine who opened the first Christian meditation centre in London in 1975: a twice-daily practice of sitting in stillness and silently repeating a single prayer word, returning to it whenever thoughts arise.

Its life rests on local groups that meet, mostly weekly, in churches, halls and homes, organised into regions that hold their own quiet days and retreats. Nationally it offers essential-teaching weekends, silent retreats and an annual conference, as well as online groups at many times of day and week. Coming up are a residential silent retreat at the Monastery of Our Lady of Hyning in Lancashire and an Advent quiet day in Bristol. Its website adds an online timer, recorded talks, a series of short spoken prefaces to meditation by David Wood and material for young adults.
